_comment: Plastic and microplastics first. tier 1 is the core beat and every query requires a plastic term. tier 2 is adjacent chemistry (PFAS, BPA) that only earns a reply when tied to plastic. General non-toxic topics are deliberately absent: they pull in conspiracy accounts and are not the brand.
_excludeNote: Accounts whose framing does not fit an education-and-research brand. Editorial call, not a fact. Edit freely.

queries.label: microplastics-research
queries.query: (microplastics OR nanoplastics) (study OR research OR scientists OR findings) min_faves:40 -filter:replies -filter:retweets lang:en

queries.label: plastic-in-the-body
queries.query: (microplastics OR nanoplastics) (blood OR brain OR placenta OR lungs OR sperm OR breast milk) min_faves:30 -filter:replies -filter:retweets lang:en

queries.label: water-filters
queries.query: ("water filter" OR "reverse osmosis" OR "filtered water") (microplastics OR nanoplastics OR plastic) min_faves:15 -filter:replies -filter:retweets lang:en

queries.label: bottled-water
queries.query: ("bottled water" OR "plastic bottle" OR "water bottle") (microplastics OR nanoplastics OR particles) min_faves:20 -filter:replies -filter:retweets lang:en

queries.label: heating-plastic
queries.query: (microwave OR "hot food" OR dishwasher OR "plastic container" OR tupperware) (microplastics OR leach OR "plastic leaching") min_faves:20 -filter:replies -filter:retweets lang:en

queries.label: baby-plastic
queries.query: ("baby bottle" OR "baby food" OR "sippy cup" OR pouches OR formula) (microplastics OR plastic OR polypropylene) min_faves:20 -filter:replies -filter:retweets lang:en

queries.label: tea-and-gum
queries.query: ("tea bag" OR teabags OR gum OR "chewing gum") (microplastics OR plastic OR polymer) min_faves:25 -filter:replies -filter:retweets lang:en

queries.label: textiles-microfibres
queries.query: (polyester OR laundry OR "synthetic fabric" OR microfibres OR microfibers) (microplastics OR "plastic fibres" OR "plastic fibers") min_faves:20 -filter:replies -filter:retweets lang:en

queries.label: indoor-air-dust
queries.query: ("indoor air" OR dust OR "house dust" OR breathing) (microplastics OR nanoplastics) min_faves:20 -filter:replies -filter:retweets lang:en

queries.label: plastic-free-recs
queries.query: ("plastic free" OR "microplastic free" OR "glass instead of plastic") (recommendations OR "any recs" OR "what do you use" OR "which brand" OR swap) min_faves:10 -filter:replies -filter:retweets lang:en

queries.label: bpa-phthalates
